notes.title: Million Depth - Demo out now & showing at TGS 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504479/b74d72c73a6bb3e1885b1ffeca7769cb44a5b222.png[/img]
The demo for Million Depth is set for release from today!
 
 The demo version of the game allows players to play through the entire alpha route, the first of the three routes in the full game.
 
 Players can enjoy core game systems in the alpha route, which also features a surprising ending that will defy expectations, as well as multiple routes that unfold depending on choices made. Data from the demo version can be transferred to the full game.
 
 Live streaming of playthroughs are of course welcomed, so feel free to involve your viewers and have fun!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504479/c0004a9278b9b69616148a34a4d2882a6d876a5c.png[/img]

 Million Depth will also be shown in playable form at Japan's largest video game event, Tokyo Game Show 2025 (9/25-9/28)!
 
 A TGS-exclusive A3-sized mini poster (double-sided) will be available at the PLAYISM booth (Hall 8, 08-S03) as a play bonus. Plus, a special stage event featuring Million Depth is scheduled to be held from 13:00-14:00 on 9/28 (Sun.). A mini live performance will be held during the event featuring the singer-songwriter and Vtuber, Ririsya - the singer of the game's theme song: Re,Future. The game's developer, αPop, will also take the stage to share behind-the-scenes development insight.

 Venue: Makuhari Messe
 *PLAYISM booth location: Hall 8, 08-S03

[h3] Ririsya Mini Live Performance Stage Event Overview[/h3]

 The latest information will be made available on the official website in anticipation of the game's November 12, 2025 release, so please take a look.

notes.title: Million Depth to be Released on November 12, 2025!
notes.content:
The deep-diving action strategy Million Depth will be released on November 12, 2025!

We've released a new trailer that features "what-if" timelines. It also features the theme song of the game, which will be performed live on stream by singer songwriter VTuber Ririsya. We're excited to reveal more about the game!

[h3]◆ New Trailer Featuring What-If Timelines[/h3]

[previewyoutube=g1TbFeXUbv8;full][/previewyoutube]
The newest trailer is accompanied by the game's theme song "Re,Future", revealed here for the very first time! In the trailer, you'll be introduced to the underground world of Million Depth, Moma across several timelines and her journey to find her only friend, the unique time-freezing, strategic combat system, the crafting screen where you can create any weapon you can imagine, and bartering shops where you can exchange for all sorts of items.

The trailer also features scenes from timelines that don't exist in the actual game, representing the title's theme of parallel worlds. Hints from the trailer can be analyzed alongside the full game experience for an even deeper understanding of the world of Million Depth.

[h3]◆ One-Route Demo Coming in September![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504479/ad616f7b0fd4d265041f15a567da5c82acf0e375.png[/img]

We will be releasing a demo on Steam in September, which features the entirety of Route α, the first route of the game. In Route α, you can get a feel for the basic game systems, as well as the beginning of a story filled with twists and turns, and finally, multiple endings depending on your actions.

Demo save data can be carried over to the full game, so please wishlist the game on Steam and look forward to the demo!
 
[h3]◆ Theme Song "Re,Future" Performed by Singer Songwriter VTuber Ririsya Live on Stream![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44504479/109d3df81db428be1fa25174f8fb547c4ded6dd9.png[/img]

The theme song of Million Depth, "Re,Future", is performed by Ririsya, a singer songwriter VTuber. For her fifth anniversary, she will have a livestream concert on YouTube today!

Ririsya's fifth anniversary concert will be split into two parts, and Re,Future will be performed live during the second half that begins at 9:00 PM (JST). She will also be watching the new trailer on stream and will share her thoughts of playing an in-development demo of the game! Of course, the concert will also feature some of Ririsya's original songs, and viewers can interact with her through the live chat.

The concert will be archived, so even if you can't make it live, you can always watch it later!

[h3]Livestream Details[/h3]

Stream Title: Ririsya's Fifth Anniversary Live (Part 2)
Time and Date: August 23, 2025, 9:00 PM (JST) onward
Platform: YouTube
URL: XXXXXXXXXXXXX

We'll continue to reveal more and more about Million Depth in the following months, so please stay tuned!

notes.title: Million Depth: Publisher and New Trailer!
notes.content:
The deep-diving action strategy game Million Depth has an announcement to make!

We're excited to announce that PLAYISM will be the publisher of this game!

As a publisher with many quality indie games under its belt, we believe they will be a reliable partner for Million Depth and its global release.

We'll work together to improve the game while preserving what makes it special, and do our best to share it with as many players as we can.

However, we will need to postpone the release date from 2024 to 2025 in order to do so.

We're very sorry to everyone who has been looking forward to the game, but we're hard at work developing the game every day, so please give us a little more time.

For now, we have a new trailer to go with this announcement. Please check it out!
[previewyoutube=KxPMt_Jnm-s;full][/previewyoutube]

In order to search for "You", dive into the million-floor-deep Naraka Akasha and freely craft your own weapons and shields. Fight to survive in unique time-freezing battles where enemies only move when you do, and discover hints about the world and maybe even other worlds parallel to it. The trailer features areas and scenes that have never been shown before, so please give it a look.

What's more, Million Depth will be showcased at Tokyo Game Show 2024 from September 26 to 29, 2024! We'll announce more details such as the booth location and free goodies we'll give out on a later date.

Please wishlist the game and look forward to more news!
